feedback:
Written before this candidate has raced, so no outcome is claimed for it. The best raced design is iteration 9 (917.47): kp 2.5, kd 1.2, ki 0, base 1.2, 16 mm sensors at x = -0.03 to +0.03 m, mass 0.6 kg, body 0.14 m. Its oval (20/20, 2.12 s) and s-bend (20/20, 2.35 s) are solid. The slalom (17/20, 3 off-track, 0.15 line-loss events, rms 0.012 m, steering oscillation 0.26, control effort 6.2) is the remaining gap. Slalom failures cost about 700 points each. The kp sweep at this spread points the same way: kp 2.0 gave 11/20 with 0.6 line-loss events (iteration 7), kp 2.25 gave 16/20 (iteration 6), and kp 2.5 gave 17/20 (iteration 9), so turn authority is the limit, not overshoot. kd has saturated (iteration 8 at kd 1.5 gave no gain). The candidate is a single-variable change from iteration 9: kp 2.5 to 2.75, with every other value unchanged. It is valid against the contract and is the natural next step on the kp trend. Approve it, since it is a small, well-grounded change from the best design and an iteration with no approval is not scored.

Read the next race this way. If slalom finishes are 18/20 or more with steering_oscillation at or below 0.3 and oval and s-bend still at 20/20, keep kp 2.75 as the reference. If steering_oscillation exceeds about 0.35, or slalom control_effort climbs well above iteration 5's 8.0, kp has passed its useful limit: return to kp 2.5 and try ki 0.1 for drift, not more kp. If slalom finishes drop below 17/20, return to kp 2.5 (the iteration 9 design, which scored 917.47). Check line_loss_events and max_error on any failing slalom run to tell line loss from overshoot.
requested_changes: If slalom finishes reach 18/20 or more with steering_oscillation at or below 0.3: keep kp 2.75 and kd 1.2 as the new reference, and consider a single base_speed step from 1.2 to 1.25 only if the slalom mean finish time stays under about 2.5 s, since iteration 9 slalom finish time was 2.49 s.

If steering_oscillation rises above 0.35 or slalom control_effort jumps above about 8 at kp 2.75: return controller.kp to 2.5, keep kd 1.2, and try controller.ki 0.1, since iteration 9 oscillation was 0.26 and iteration 5 (kp 3.0 on a wider spread) reached control effort 8.0.
If slalom finishes fall below 17/20 at kp 2.75: revert controller.kp to 2.5 (the iteration 9 design, score 917.47), since iteration 6 at kp 2.25 gave 16/20 and the lower-gain trend is worse.
